title: Rectangular bar
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw the first two-dimensional sketch on the first face. This involves creating a loop that consists of twelve lines. Begin with the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.1406, 0.0), followed by the second line to (0.1875, 0.0187), the third line to (0.5625, 0.0187), the fourth line to (0.6094, 0.0), the fifth line to (0.75, 0.0), the sixth line vertically up to (0.75, 0.0937), the seventh line back to (0.6094, 0.0937), the eighth line to (0.5625, 0.075), the ninth line to (0.1875, 0.075), the tenth line to (0.1406, 0.0937), the eleventh line to (0.0, 0.0937), and finally the twelfth line back to the origin. After completing the sketch, apply a scaling factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0187 units in the positive normal direction to create the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Finally, integrate the part by creating a new solid body from this extrusion. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar with rounded edges are a length of 0.75, a width of 0.0937, and a height of 0.0187.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.1406, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.1875, 0.0187) \
     .lineTo(0.5625, 0.0187) \
     .lineTo(0.6094, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.0937) \
     .lineTo(0.6094, 0.0937) \
     .lineTo(0.5625, 0.075) \
     .lineTo(0.1875, 0.075) \
     .lineTo(0.1406, 0.0937) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0937) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch
r = r.extrude(0.0187)

# The final model is represented as 'r'

import cadquery as cq

# Tensile test specimen (dog-bone shape)
W_end = 0.0937 / 2.0   # half width of end blocks
W_gauge = 0.0937 / 4.0 # half width of gauge section
T = 0.0187             # thickness

x0 = 0.0
x1 = 0.174   # start of taper
x2 = 0.250   # gauge start
x3 = 0.500   # gauge end
x4 = 0.576   # taper end
x5 = 0.750   # end of part

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(x0, W_end)
    .lineTo(x1, W_end)
    .lineTo(x2, W_gauge)
    .lineTo(x3, W_gauge)
    .lineTo(x4, W_end)
    .lineTo(x5, W_end)
    .lineTo(x5, -W_end)
    .lineTo(x4, -W_end)
    .lineTo(x3, -W_gauge)
    .lineTo(x2, -W_gauge)
    .lineTo(x1, -W_end)
    .lineTo(x0, -W_end)
    .close()
    .extrude(T)
)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

L = 0.7500
W = 0.0937
T = 0.0187

# Dog-bone style flat plate, symmetric about the X axis
x1 = 0.14375
x2 = 0.19375
x3 = L - x2
x4 = L - x1

w_end = W
w_mid = 0.0562

pts = [
    (0.0, -w_end / 2),
    (x1,  -w_end / 2),
    (x2,  -w_mid / 2),
    (x3,  -w_mid / 2),
    (x4,  -w_end / 2),
    (L,   -w_end / 2),
    (L,    w_end / 2),
    (x4,   w_end / 2),
    (x3,   w_mid / 2),
    (x2,   w_mid / 2),
    (x1,   w_end / 2),
    (0.0,  w_end / 2),
]

r = cq.Workplane("XY").polyline(pts).close().extrude(T)
